policy:
OPT-IN ONLY (Part 3.3): a target is monitored ONLY by appearing here, with an explicit schedule the operator wrote. Nothing is scheduled by default. The authorized-targets.json gate still applies at every scan on top of this file; this config adds scheduling, not authorization. Alert policy (Part 3.2): REGRESSED findings (previously FIXED, present again) and NEW CRITICAL-severity findings fire the webhook; stable RECURRING-only runs are silent.

ROUND-12 PART 2.2 — this file is ALSO the project's own dogfood reference: the one configured target is the repo's OWN bundled fixture app (fixtures/vulnapp.py — self-hosted, ownership-proof per authorized-targets.json 'self-hosted-fixtures'). It is the worked example other users copy: replace target/store/schedule with their own authorized target. Real firing evidence: evidence/layers/continuous-monitoring/ (round 11: the vulnerable->fixed->re-broken REGRESSED alert, byte-verified at a local webhook collector) and evidence/layers/self-sca/ monitor-dogfood/ (round 12: the 2-run lifecycle simulation).

targets.schedule_note: weekly Monday 03:42 UTC — the same cadence as this repo's other unattended validations; override per target
targets.owner_note: the fixture must be up before the scan — the runner starts it itself from the 'fixture' field (round-12 part 2.2); self-hosted cron users get the same behavior via scripts/monitor/run_due.py --target dogfood-vulnapp
